answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable onyx bond before it can trade, and let reputation grow only from completed work countersigned by independent peers. A single inlet of new identities cannot flood the market, because each fake identity must lock its own bond and repeat the whole work history. Onboarding stays velvet-smooth, but fraud proven against any identity forfeits its bond, so manufacturing a thousand sybils costs a thousand bonds plus a thousand histories, far more than the gain from one rigged deal.
